name: MTE Flow
description: Start and watch MTE Flow runs on stock Orca: install MTE in a workspace, pin the worker agent, launch the planner and follow runs and workers.

statusBarItems.tooltip: MTE Flow: active workers. Click to open the panel.

settings.title: Planner agent
settings.description: Agent that runs the MTE planner.

settings.title: Planner model
settings.description: Prefilled in the start-run form and passed to the planner launch. Leave empty for the agent's own default.

settings.title: Planner surface
settings.description: How the planner opens: native chat or a terminal. Workers always run in terminals.

settings.title: Planner effort
settings.description: Reasoning effort for the planner (claude, antigravity). Needs a planner model.

settings.title: Coder agent
settings.description: Agent pinned for the coder workers (and any worker without a role of its own).

settings.title: Coder model
settings.description: Pinned with `mte pin set`. Leave empty to skip the pin.

settings.title: Coder effort
settings.description: Reasoning effort for the pinned coder (claude, antigravity).

settings.title: QA agent
settings.description: Agent pinned for the validator and QA workers (`mte dispatch --role qa`).

settings.title: QA model
settings.description: Pinned with `mte pin set --role qa`. Leave empty to let QA workers use the coder pin.

settings.title: QA effort
settings.description: Reasoning effort for the pinned QA worker (claude, antigravity).

settings.title: mte binary
settings.description: Command or absolute path of the MTE CLI. Install it with `npm i -g https://github.com/MTEKode/mte-flow-plugin/releases/download/mte-v0.8.4/mtekode-mte-0.8.4.tgz`; from a checkout of https://github.com/MTEKode/mte-flow-plugin use `cd packages/mte && npm link`.
